The data do not establish capacity for four people, a quiet residential setting, the layout or net area of a room exclusively dedicated to children, or authorization for nursery use. The verified regional standard specifies 5 sqm of net useful area per child in that dedicated room, with a minimum dedicated-room area of 15 sqm; it is not a gross-area threshold for the whole property. Urban-planning compatibility, applicable authorization procedures, and the listed safety, hygiene, accessibility, and building checks need verification. Confirm which regulatory regime applies at the application date, given the stated transition to D.G.R. 3-1937/2025.
pros: Reported gross floor area of 414 sqm is well above the requested 95 sqm.
Residential dwelling type and energy class C align with the home-setting objective and preferred energy threshold.
Green-space proximity percentile is 70.3, supporting the preference for nearby green areas.
cons: Capacity for four people, room layout, and suitability as a quiet residential setting are not established by the supplied data.
No evidence confirms a net dedicated children’s room meeting the verified 5 sqm per child standard and 15 sqm minimum.
Nursery-use compatibility and required planning, authorization, hygiene, accessibility, and safety checks remain to be verified.
